regression: CSV confirmation failed before the API request when crypto.randomUUID was unavailable, leaving submission controls busy.
solution: Native UUID when available; otherwise UUID v4 using crypto.getRandomValues. No weak random fallback. Key creation is inside the CSV try/finally and pre-request failures are not uncertain API outcomes.

browserContext.result: CSV commit succeeds; an uncertain retry keeps the exact Idempotency-Key; no unhandled page error.

http401: Endpoint of the user's 401 was not provided. Authentication is unchanged. Import 401 feedback requests sign-in; no automatic retry or false success.

guide.verification: Unchanged verifier checked current runtime source hash, image hashes, masks, no decodable QR and rendered manuals.

qaSelection: Explicit tests target the shared key generator, CSV panel, Wizard model/flow and two browser regressions. Transitive related selection through the router would expand to unrelated Client tests.
